articles.title: Arm Stock Verdict Risk Grows After Qualcomm License Breach Ruling
articles.description: Arm Holdings recently faced an adverse Delaware jury verdict that found the firm breached its architectural license agreement with Qualcomm and intentionally disrupted Qualcomm’s business, adding legal and operational pressure on its licensing model. The ruling directly challenges Arm Holdings’ relationships with major chip partners at the same time the firm is pushing deeper into higher value AGI CPU and compute subsystems licensing.
